correctness.rationale: Use the ordinary tensor equation directly, so there is no division by 3! in small characteristic. Write M for the skew coefficient matrix of r. In the coordinate ([x_i,x_j],x_i,x_j) interpreted in the signed basis, only [r12,r13] can contribute, since the other two terms place the bracket in a V slot. Of the bracket summands, only the (x_i,x_j) pair and its reverse can give that central direction; one term uses diagonal entries and is zero, the other gives a_ij^2 with the appropriate sign. Thus all three a_ij vanish over a field. With A=0, each surviving bracket uses two x slots and leaves two central slots; the resulting tensor is the alternating image of the sum of [x_i,x_j] wedge w_i wedge w_j over cyclic pairs (1,2),(2,3),(3,1). Its z1 tensor z2 tensor z3 coefficient is Q, and C is absent. Independent symbolic tensor expansion gave signed squares a12^2, -a13^2, a23^2, followed after setting A=0 by exactly six signed copies of Q, and determinant 2 for the chosen nine-coordinate coboundary map. Hence all differences of B that give the same map vanish in odd characteristic. The polar form is the direct sum of three nonsingular hyperbolic planes and the diagonal-entry block of determinant 2. Rank 9 rules out factorization over the algebraic closure and the polar gradient vanishes only at B=0. The odd-rank finite-field quadratic character sum gives q^8 zeros: in the additive-character counting average the nonzero scalars contribute proportional to their quadratic character, which sums to zero. The q^3 unrestricted C choices give q^11 tensors but do not affect the q^8 maps.
residual_risks: Only the reduced alternating locus is identified; no assertion about the full equation scheme, characteristic 2, nonalternating r, or isomorphism classes of cobrackets. The binary experiment in the frozen notes is out of scope.

value.rationale: Free rank three is the first two-step free case whose center admits a nonzero alternating three-form: it is where the central compatibility condition can differ from the vanishing tensor equation. The result gives a usable complete triangular parameter space there, with a singularity description and a check on how tensor representatives differ from actual distinct cobracket maps. The finite counts add a precise benchmark but are consequences, not the sole contribution.
residual_risks: A specific small free algebra; the result does not classify triangular structures up to automorphisms, make a higher-rank claim, or give a scheme-theoretic classification.
